title: Rate These Cafe Crimes From One to Ten

scenes.say: Rate these cafe crimes from one to ten. The last one is unforgivable.
Crime one. Ordering at the register while still on a phone call. That's a six.

props.caption: Crime one: *a six*
props.name: Kim
props.role: on a call at the register
props.quote: Hang on, Mom. What *sizes* do you have?

scenes.say: Crime two. A party of eight walks in two minutes before close. And they want separate checks. Eight out of ten.
And crime three. A one-star review, for being closed on Thanksgiving.

props.caption: Crime three
props.name: Brad
props.text: Drove all the way over and they were CLOSED on Thanksgiving.
props.reply: Our team was home with their families. Happy Thanksgiving! We open Friday at 7.

scenes.say: Ten out of ten. Unforgivable. Your team deserves the day off.
What would you give a ten? Tell us in the comments. Follow for more cafe life.
